subject: Re: MAGNET kickoff: magnitude estimation as a service
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing and compute locked in.

People: Tereza 80% on features/benchmarks and the caching layer, Ondrej 60% on the model and evaluation-vs-benchmarks work, Paloma 50% on catalog ingestion and the conda/pip packaging (the current env setup is fragile; she's pinning it properly).

Compute: small through April - feature and benchmark computation is CPU-bound and cached, training runs fit on a handful of Titan A100s. The June sweep is the exception. Ines has us down for the vulcan-h100 reservation - 128 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-15 - which is when the full catalog-scale training sweep runs. That's the only reserved capacity we need all window, and it's the schedule anchor for everything upstream: features and benchmarks for all catalogs must be cached by June 12.

Flag: Vulcan maintenance is June 22-24, right after our week, so there's zero slack for a rerun. If the sweep slips, it slips to July.

Daniela
